CA.rationale: No explicit attention/processing condition linked to identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (p0/current/n0 red), an explicit origin/organization field for that content, and their separation are all present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No attention/allocation or content-processing condition explicitly linked to content organization/access.

C.rationale: The report names specific content identifiers (e.g. p0/current/n0) and attributes (red/blue) with explicit value sets.

D.rationale: Content/attribute entries and separate origin/organization metadata are both present for the same referent, distinguishing identification from status/organization.

O.rationale: The report provides explicit origin/representation metadata describing how the content is represented/accessed (kind, record_time, represented_time).
